Observation.NoFolders: Save at least one existing folder outside excluded space, data and model directories.
Classification.CredentialNotice: Windows: Save uses Credential Manager for this user. Other systems stay session-only. Clearing the session does not delete a saved key; loading never grants cloud consent.
Classification.KeySaved: Saved in Windows Credential Manager. Sending permission is off.
Classification.KeyLoaded: Loaded for this session. Allow sending explicitly before a preview.
Classification.KeyDeleted: Saved key and this session cleared.

Classification.KeyStoreFailed: The OS credential store is unavailable or the key format/size is unsupported. No alternative storage is used.

Classification.JevSetup: Select Jev and save settings. Enter your TypeSafe key and allow sending below, then request a preview. The default is session-only. Explicit rate-limit refusals may retry twice within 45 seconds; longer server waits require a new action.
Classification.JevConsent: Allow sending filenames, types, category names/descriptions and my optional notes to TypeSafe AI this session. API usage may be charged. No automatic file-content or absolute-path upload.
Classification.JevResultNotice: TypeSafe AI receives names, types, category descriptions and your optional note. No automatic file-content or path upload; no file or workspace changes.
Classification.JevRunning: Requesting a Jev cloud preview… Cancel from the context menu.
Classification.Setup: Download or install a trusted Laya model package, then save settings. You can also choose an existing bundle containing manifest.json.
Classification.Running: Generating suggestions on the local CPU… Cancel from the context menu.
Classification.Cancelled: Classification preview cancelled. Files are unchanged.
Classification.Stale: Spaces or settings changed. The old suggestion was discarded; preview again.
Classification.ReadOnly: Read-only suggestion from names, types, category descriptions and your optional note. No file contents are read or files moved. Checksums do not authenticate the model publisher.
Welcome.Title: DeskNext Native Desktop Shell
Welcome.Subtitle: A structured desktop paradigm: dual-mode spaces, semantic sorting, and reversible file lifecycles.
Welcome.ManagedDesc: Files physically reside in application-managed directory (~/DeskNest/Spaces), providing lifecycle management, collision avoidance, and reversible undo.
Welcome.MappedDesc: Maps existing user directories without moving files, preserving original paths while providing structured window organization.
Template.OfficeDesc: Commercial contracts, financial spreadsheets, presentation slides, reference archives
Template.DevelopmentDesc: Source repositories, architecture docs, build artifacts, diagnostic logs
Template.CreativeDesc: Design master files, high-res images, audio/video footage, typography fonts
Template.CustomDesc: Freely define your own space hierarchy, storage paths, and rules

Operations.Title: Operation History & Transaction Log
Operations.Subtitle: Inspect persisted file movement and transaction lifecycle states; records reflect Core truthfully with no fake undo
Operations.Empty: No operation records yet. Committed file movements or transactions will be recorded here truthfully.
Operations.DescProposed: Operation proposed by model or rule resolver; no physical file changes executed yet.
Operations.DescPendingUser: Transaction is awaiting explicit user authorization or manual trigger.
Operations.DescCompleted: Physical move transaction successfully executed and synchronized with workspace metadata.
Operations.DescUndone: Physical move transaction successfully undone; file safely restored to its original space and path.
Operations.DescRecoveryRequired: Transaction interrupted or state anomaly detected; system halted in fail-closed safety state.
Operations.RecoveryRequiredAction: [Action Required] Physical commit incomplete or journal corrupted. Inspect the recovery journal in data directory and verify filesystem state before retrying.
Operations.NoUndoNotice: Audit Notice: Operations are an immutable transaction log. Automatic undo and blind reversal are unavailable to prevent data loss; only verified Completed operations expose identity-checked manual undo.
Operations.ManualMoveGatedNotice: Manual move is gated: Core transaction coordinator not attached; direct File.Move is prohibited
Operations.ManualMoveReadyNotice: Core transaction coordinator is attached; controlled manual move is available
Operations.UndoGatedNotice: Manual undo is gated: Core transaction coordinator not attached; direct File.Move is prohibited
Operations.UndoReadyNotice: Core transaction coordinator is attached; controlled manual undo is available
Files.CapabilityManagedDesc: Physical file residing in DeskNext managed storage with journaled transactions and reversible deletion.
Files.CapabilityMappedDesc: External reference pointing to existing directory. Removal only unmaps catalog reference; source file is preserved.
Files.GatedNotice: Action is gated: Injectable executor is not attached; direct filesystem mutations are prohibited
Files.OpenGatedNotice: Open is gated: Platform launcher is not attached
Files.OpenReadyNotice: Platform launcher is attached; open file is ready
Files.PreviewGatedNotice: Preview is gated: Preview host is not attached
Files.PreviewReadyNotice: Preview host is attached; quick preview is ready
Files.CopyGatedNotice: Manual copy/paste supports only cataloged items on Windows NTFS.
Files.CopyReadyNotice: Copy this cataloged item on Windows NTFS; the source stays in place.
Files.CutGatedNotice: Cut is gated: Clipboard coordinator is not attached
Files.CutReadyNotice: Clipboard coordinator is attached; cut is ready
Files.PasteGatedNotice: Paste is gated: Clipboard coordinator is not attached
Files.PasteReadyNotice: Clipboard coordinator is attached; paste is ready
Files.RenameGatedNotice: Rename is gated: Core transaction coordinator not attached
Files.RenameReadyNotice: Core transaction coordinator attached; rename is ready
Files.DeleteGatedNotice: Delete/Remove is gated: Core transaction coordinator not attached
Files.DeleteReadyNotice: Core transaction coordinator attached; delete/remove is ready
Files.DeleteConfirmPrompt: Move '{0}' to the DeskNext recovery area? It can be restored from history and will not be sent to the OS Recycle Bin.
Files.DeleteManagedSuccessNotice: Moved '{0}' to recovery area. Restore anytime from Operation History.
Files.DeleteMappedSuccessNotice: Removed '{0}' from space catalog. Source file preserved.
